# Copilot

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before you change this repository. It is the shared instruction file for Copilot, Claude, Codex, Cursor, and any other assistant.

Then read [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md), [docs/PRODUCT_BRIEF.md](../docs/PRODUCT_BRIEF.md), [docs/DECISIONS.md](../docs/DECISIONS.md), and [docs/TASKS.md](../docs/TASKS.md). Follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Name GitHub Copilot in the pull request body when it produced the work. Update the decision log and the task board in the same pull request when they change. Do not commit secrets. Do not push to `main`.
